subject: POC environment access & ownership — action items and owners needed
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
To: harper@novaforge.com, alex.moreno@novaforge.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC environment access & ownership — action items and owners needed

Hi Harper / Alex —

Thanks again for the run-through this morning. Per our discovery call, I pulled together a concise set of MAP milestones focused on the POC environment access work so we can agree owners and target dates. This is the minimum infra/security work we need to unblock a short proof-of-concept (3–4 day validation window):

POC environment access dependencies (proposed owners & asks)
- VPC peering (required) — owner: Novaforge cloud infra (please confirm VPC IDs + desired CIDR ranges). We’ll provide the peer config snippets for AWS/GCP.
- IP allowlist (app & control plane) — owner: Novaforge SecOps. Provide list of NAT/public IPs (or CIDR) we should allow, and whether dynamic IP announces are permitted.
- SSO / SAML integration (idP) — owner: Novaforge SSO team. We support SAML 2.0 (IdP metadata + attributes). We need a test service account and one test user for validation.
- Secrets / KMS access pattern — owner: Novaforge security/infra. Do you prefer Redwood to integrate with your KMS (customer-managed keys) or to use Redwood-managed keys for the POC?

Deliverables we’ll provide from Redwood: MAP draft (attached), network peer templates, SAML metadata we host for validation, and a short runbook for smoke tests once peering + allowlists are applied.

Ask: can you confirm owners and a target date for "network/identity baseline" by EOD Thursday (2026-10-16)? If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute technical sync next week to walk the infra people through the peer/allowlist steps.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone table), novaforge_network_requirements.pdf (network checklist)

Thanks —

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

---
Note: Sean will join the technical sync and Karthik can support SSO/KMS questions.

From: harper@novaforge.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alex.moreno@novaforge.com, ops+security@novaforge.com, sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC environment access & ownership — action items and owners needed

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear list and the draft MAP. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifying requests:  

- VPC peering: owner confirmed = Alex Moreno (cloud infra). VPC IDs: vpc-0a1b2c3d (us-west-2) <-> please confirm Redwood peer VPC CIDR expected. Target to complete peering: 2026-10-20.
- IP allowlist: owner = Novaforge SecOps (ops+security@novaforge.com). We will provide the full NAT egress IPs by Monday (2026-10-19). Note: SecOps prefers whitelisting CIDRs at the app load balancer and control plane layer.
- SSO / SAML: owner = Harper Lee (marshalling the IdP side) + Alex for the technical bits. We can provide IdP metadata; prefer to test against a staging SAML app. We will create a test user (harper.test@novaforge.com). Target: complete metadata exchange and first login test by 2026-10-22.
- Secrets / KMS: owner = Alex. For the POC we prefer Redwood-managed keys to avoid onboarding our KMS for such a short window — can you confirm Redwood-managed KMS is acceptable? If we move to customer-managed keys later, we will open a separate ticket.

A couple of asks from our side:  
- Please send the SAML SP metadata and a short checklist of required attributes (email, groups) so our IdP team can wire it up quickly.
- Can Redwood share a one-page network diagram showing which ports we need to open between the peered VPCs and the control plane endpoints?

I’ve copied SecOps and Alex. We can do the 30-minute technical sync — we’re available Tue/Wed next week (2026-10-19 or 2026-10-20) afternoon PST.

Thanks,

Harper Lee
Head of IT | Novaforge
harper@novaforge.com

Great — thanks for the confirmations, Harper (and Alex). Short sync notes and next steps below.

Confirmed owners & target dates
- VPC peering: Alex Moreno — target 2026-10-20 (you suggested afternoon PST). Redwood action: we will provide the peer configuration template and route table guidance by EOD 2026-10-19.
- IP allowlist: SecOps — target IP list by 2026-10-19. Redwood note: we will share the control-plane and app egress IPs for whitelisting.
- SSO/SAML: Harper + Alex — target first login test by 2026-10-22. Redwood action: SP metadata + required attributes sent now (attached: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx contains the attribute list).
- KMS: Alex confirmed temporary Redwood-managed keys for POC. We’ll re-evaluate for production.

Scheduled: Technical sync confirmed for Tue 2026-10-20 2:30pm PST — invite sent to the thread. Agenda: peer steps, allowlist locations, SAML exchange, smoke test runbook. Please add any extra items.

Attachments included in thread: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx, novaforge_network_requirements.pdf

If anything changes on your side, reply to this thread. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the templates and the sync.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com (on cc for sync)
